preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
Attacker must have some initial token balance to exploit the burn function

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the burn() and mint() functions which incorrectly use reflection values instead of token amounts. As owner, call mint() with a small amount to create tokens, then call burn() with a large reflection value to burn far fewer tokens than intended, resulting in net token gain. Specifically: 1. Call mint(attacker_address, 1) to add 1 token. 2. Call burn(large_reflection_value) where large_reflection_value is much larger than the token equivalent due to the reflection rate. The burn function subtracts the reflection value directly from _rOwned but only subtracts the same value from _tTotal (not converted to token amount), allowing you to burn very few actual tokens while appearing to burn many.
